name: Nederlandse Cybersecuritystrategie 2022–2028
description: Nederlandse Cybersecuritystrategie 2022–2028 (October 10, 2022). Cabinet-wide Netherlands Cybersecurity Strategy (2022–2028) structured around four pillars and accompanied by an integrated Action Plan and annual progress monitoring by the NCTV and NCSC-NL.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Rijksoverheid (Government of the Netherlands) (rijksoverheid.nl) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Rijksoverheid (Government of the Netherlands) (rijksoverheid.nl).

license.note: Official national strategy publication (rijksoverheid.nl); publicly released for free download, policy reference, and research.
